Helpful clues

Get urgent help for: A sudden “worst-ever” headache, new weakness or confusion, seizure, fainting, fever with a stiff neck, major vision change, significant injury, or a new headache during pregnancy or postpartum.

Patterns overlap. This learning tool cannot diagnose an individual headache.
